progress.summary: Cross-platform initiative (Windows + macOS, Linux deferred). Phases 1-5 implemented and unit-tested on Windows. The macOS adapter is implemented but has never run on a Mac; interactive validation on macOS Tahoe is the single next action before the feature can be called complete.

platform.name: windows
platform.note: Adapter wraps existing Win32 modules; behavior unchanged.

platform.name: macos
platform.note: All macOS code is new and untested on hardware: CGWindowList identity, ScreenCaptureKit capture, AXUIElement probe, pynput hotkey, TCC checks. PyObjC/pynput dependencies are declared but not yet installed anywhere.

action.title: Interactive macOS validation on a Tahoe machine
action.details: Run the 14-row acceptance matrix in docs/Cross-Platform-Execution-Plan.md ("macOS Validation Matrix"). Setup: python3 -m venv .venv; pip install -e .; grant Screen Recording and Accessibility to the terminal; set ui_enabled = true. Smoke probes first: python -m labguide.platforms.macos.ax_probe --pid <pid> python -m labguide.platforms.macos.ax_probe --help Then the full TUI flow: hotkey capture in TextEdit, return to LabGuide, submit with backend.
action.on-completion: Check off matrix rows in docs/Cross-Platform-Execution-Plan.md, flip Phase 4 "Interactive validation" to done, update this file.

action.title: Fix whatever the validation matrix breaks
action.details: Likely first-failure candidates (untested code paths): PyObjC ScreenCaptureKit completion-handler bridging, AX attribute names/types, pynput chord mapping, Retina point-vs-pixel geometry alignment between AX bounds and screenshot pixels.

action.title: Windows interactive regression pass
action.details: Confirm the adapter refactor changed nothing: existing matrix in docs/UI-Context-Capture-Execution-Plan.md (Notepad, error dialog, browser, elevated app, UIA timeout, secondary monitor).

action.title: Windows Graphics Capture for true window contents
action.details: Windows window capture still crops the visible desktop, so overlapping windows can appear in the screenshot. macOS already has true window capture via ScreenCaptureKit. Deferred future work; listed in the execution plan's Deferred section.

invariants.invariant: Capture creates a local pending attachment; only explicit submit sends data.
Password/secure controls are redacted before serialization or logging.
Accessibility extraction runs in a child process with a parent-enforced hard timeout.
Screenshot-only and text-only paths must survive any accessibility failure.
OS API calls stay inside labguide.platforms adapters; PyObjC/pynput imports stay lazy.
Image and response size limits are enforced before request construction.
